info.title: IDPGitOps — F-002 Management plane arbitration events
info.description: Empty. Both controllers are poll loops: the lease runner ticks on a fixed interval [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/bloblease/runner.go:78] and the scaling runner reconciles from the cluster-local status object [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/scaling/runner.go:113]. No broker client, topic literal or subscription appears in either package, so there is no asynchronous contract to describe.
